reviews.review: A lot more fun than it looks like, I only bothered because it was on sale and was pleasantly surprised. If you see it on sale and like horde shooters, give it a go.

Back 4 Blood is an exciting and energetic co-op shooter that truly shines when played with friends.
It captures the spirit of Left 4 Dead 2 but delivers it with modern graphics, richer visual details, and smoother animations.

The level design and enemy variety keep the tension high and the action constant.

However, if you play it solo, you’ll miss out on the game’s real charm Back 4 Blood was built for group play.
If you have a few gaming friends, this title can give you hours of fun, laughter, and chaotic zombie-slaying moments.
